mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate consistently reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative sentiment shifts that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes (indicated by industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months), manufacturing output constraints reduce corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the periods when INDPRO is below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation acceleration exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals the Federal Reserve's likely tightening response, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations to produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (indicated by high housing starts and strong retail sales), the economy approaches capacity constraints, triggering inflationary pressures and potential Fed tightening that results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 450000 (both in the prior month).
